Noah (PM): Gatekeeper sync  Need a concise 'go/no-go' checklist for GA tomorrow. Items: SLA wording, legal signoff, support coverage, monitoring dashboards, pricing bands for pilots. Who claims what?
Arun (SRE): I'll own SLA + alerts. Two ops asks: call out maintenance windows explicitly and add a warmup exclusion for autoscale events. Will add matrices for Dedicated/Private failover behavior.
Linh (Eng): Runtime note: cache cold-starts can raise p95 briefly during shard scale. Propose SLA exclusion: 'first 10m after capacity changes' and recommend canary ramping. Also adding fallback variant route if p99 > 2s.
Sophie (Support): Support plan: 2-week 24/7 burn-in rota, then business-hours with on-call fallback. I'll publish playbooks and canned templates for pilot customers.
Raj (Sales): Commercial: pilots want a capped pilot price and a billed-backstop (30% buffer). We need a sales signoff checkbox in provisioning. Also request billing grace for first 72h during migrations.
Noah (PM): Legal?
Arun (SRE): Acceptance (SLA/ops): SLA doc redlined + legal reviewed; maintenance & warmup exclusion added; canary bleed window configured and tested; PagerDuty alert on SLO breach set.
Linh (Eng): Acceptance (Runtime): KV-prefill job running in staging; fallback model variant enabled; perf smoke with 95/99 targets passing; rollout flags set.
Sophie (Support): Acceptance (Support): Rota published with backups; incident playbooks & canned replies live; KB entries for maintenance and expected behavior.
Raj (Sales): Acceptance (Commercial): Pilot pricing documented; provisioning requires sales_approval_id; billing grace policy added.
deploy-bot: Staging smoke scheduled for 2024-06-18T18:00Z. Results will be attached to this thread.
Noah (PM): Anything blocking the 'green' decision if all acceptance checks pass?
Arun (SRE): Need legal signoff on liability caps for pilots.
Linh (Eng): Need a short tech appendix in SLA about perf caveats.
Sophie (Support): Need an autoresponder for planned maintenance windows.
Raj (Sales): Need the provisioning checkbox implemented. Small UI change only.
Noah (PM): Ok — let's file the remaining micro-tasks and aim to close by EOD. I'll collate and post the final checklist for thumbs-up tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
